verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS platform that exposes an API and MCP server through service keys and OAuth, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence mentions API versioning, version identifiers, changelogs, or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
